pages.title: 56th GST Council — two-tier GST of 5% and 18% (GST 2.0)

facts.text: Meeting: 56th GST Council, 3 September 2025, chaired by Nirmala Sitharaman — 10.5-hour meeting
facts.head: News

facts.text: New slabs: 5% and 18% (earlier 0, 5, 12, 18, 28%) — effective 22 September 2025
facts.head: News

facts.text: Sin/demerit goods: 40% (cigarettes, paan masala) — highest slab
facts.head: News

facts.text: Compensation cess: continues on tobacco until loans repaid
facts.head: News

facts.text: Item: All TVs; New GST: 18%
facts.head: News

facts.text: Item: Individual health insurance; New GST: Nil
facts.head: News

facts.text: Item: Life-saving cancer drugs; New GST: Nil
facts.head: News

facts.text: Inverted duty structure to be corrected
facts.head: News

facts.text: Revenue impact: ~₹48,000 crore; Revenue Secretary Arvind Shrivastava
facts.head: News

facts.text: Decision: unanimous; Bihar Dy CM Samrat Choudhary, UP FM Suresh Khanna
facts.head: News

facts.text: Slabs dropped: 12% and 28%; retained 0, 5, 18% + 40% demerit rate (some special rates below 5%)
facts.head: Economic implications

facts.text: 546 goods changed — over 80% cuts, ~20% increases
facts.head: Economic implications

facts.text: ⚠ 28% → 40% for some goods reflects merger of compensation cess, not a real hike
facts.head: Economic implications

facts.text: ⚠ Exempt goods get no Input Tax Credit
facts.head: Economic implications

facts.text: Q1 nominal GDP: 8.8% vs 10.1% projected; direct taxes -4.3%
facts.head: Economic implications

facts.text: Revenue foregone (with income tax reforms): ~₹1 lakh crore
facts.head: Economic implications

facts.text: Called: "GST Bachat Utsav" by PM Modi
facts.head: Economic implications

facts.text: Classification fixes: all Indian breads — roti, paratha, khakhra — exempt; similar goods in same slab (e.g. salted vs caramelised popcorn)
facts.head: Economic implications

pages.title: Quality Control Orders (QCOs)

facts.text: Law: BIS Act, 2016 — Section 16 lets govt make Standard Mark compulsory
facts.head: Framework

facts.text: Standards: ~23,000 BIS standards, most voluntary; QCO makes them mandatory
facts.head: Framework

facts.text: Schemes: 10 Conformity Assessment Schemes (7 products; 1 each management systems, services, processes); Scheme-I most common
facts.head: Framework

facts.text: Process: draft hosted on WTO TBT website; usually 6 months for compliance
facts.head: Framework

facts.text: Hermetic compressors: <2 million (2021-22) → 8 million (2023-24); room ACs ~1 million → 12 million
facts.head: Impact and criticism

facts.text: Birla Aircon, Meerut: turnover ₹7 crore → ₹42 crore
facts.head: Impact and criticism

facts.text: Critic: NITI Aayog VC Suman Berry called QCOs a "malign intervention"
facts.head: Impact and criticism

facts.text: Reforms: "Manak Manthan"; certification in 30 days for 750+ products; ~80% of 50,753 certificates to MSMEs
facts.head: Impact and criticism
